name: Interactive and text sigma editors
plain: Nodes where the user draws or types the curve. The digest shows many of these; a few were read: a graph with points evaluated at step positions, a sigma editor taking JSON edits, a curve with point interpolation scaled by sigma_max.
math: σ_i = f(position_i)·σmax for user curve f (WepeNerd), or a whole JSON list of the same length replacing the input (LG), or piecewise points (TWan).

providers.author: JoeNavark
providers.note: Control points are interpolated (linear, quadratic or cubic by point count, or the JS widget's dense samples), sampled at 'steps' positions (not steps+1), then remapped by a straight-line fit so the first value is start_y and the last is end_y. No 0 is appended unless end_y is 0 (the default).

providers.author: Nekodificador
providers.note: Drawn curve evaluated as a weighted NURBS (degree up to 3, per-point weights 1 to 10) or piecewise linear; σ_i = f(i/n)·max_sigma with max_sigma capped at 1, so it only suits flow models; last value forced to 0. Also outputs the values as a float list.

label: from code

audit.note: sigmas_editor.py:61-65: LG does not override per index. The JSON list replaces the whole schedule when its length matches, and is ignored otherwise. The last value is forced back to 0 if the input ended at 0.
